connector.name: ProdPoke
connector.registryDescription: AI QA tester - real browsers scan sites for bugs, SEO, perf, and accessibility issues via chat.
connector.summary: Hosted at prodpoke.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the prodpoke account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token in the form 'Bearer pp_...'. Create one at https://prodpoke.com/app/settings/keys
